weaknesses: The central KL mechanism is inconsistently specified. Equation 16 and Algorithm 1 use KL(new || old), whereas Equation 20 estimates KL(old || new). Equation 13 is not a valid TD-lambda mixture: its denominator can become negative at the reported lambda, and its return index does not track the summation index. Training budgets require clarification. Section 4 and Table 1 describe 50-million-step REPPO experiments, but Figures 4 and 10–12 display REPPO trajectories extending to 200 million steps. The ablations do not establish the claimed importance of joint entropy/KL adaptation. Removing KL entirely does not distinguish joint tuning from fixed penalties or adaptation of only one multiplier. Using one configuration across tasks supports transferability, but does not establish the advertised robustness to hyperparameter choices without sensitivity experiments.

The 'reliable performance' curve is nondecreasing by construction under its future-threshold definition; its shape therefore cannot independently demonstrate stable policy improvement, and its final value reduces to final threshold attainment.

Section 5 incorrectly describes V-MPO as off-policy and overlooks optimized KL dual variables in MPO/V-MPO. Correct positioning and comparison against a relevant adaptive-KL on-policy baseline would better establish what REPPO adds.

The memory and runtime claims exceed the measurements. Wall-clock results cover JAX implementations against PPO, omit FastTD3, and Appendix B acknowledges less favorable Torch behavior.
